items.title: 52060_Eddie Barefield oral history interview
items.q: Cliff Jackson came down and, oh, I had Cliff Jackson

ctx.x: Cliff Jackson came down and, oh, I had Cliff Jackson, and I can give you a name of all the stride piano players that they were looking for to come down there, and they weren't satisfied with any of them. So I just said, well, forget it. You get somebody.

So they come up with Johnny Mehegan. So now we -- we got a trumpet, clarinet, drums and piano. So we go into rehearsal for the show. Now, the -- so now, Maheema Nigrel was the musical director. He didn't know anything about jazz or what it was supposed to do, says, Barefield, it's up to you.
